positions.name: MeridianGateDirective
positions.frame: what gate does Meridian deployment now require, and what incident triggered it?
positions.why: src-1 states the CTO's directive that every Meridian deployment requires a signed release manifest before shipping; src-2 supplies the motivating incident — two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter. Together they read as the authority establishing the gate and its stated rationale.

positions.name: MeridianGateDecisionRecord
positions.frame: what did the conversation settle as the parameters of the Meridian deployment gate decision?
positions.why: src-3 restates the gate requirement as a settled rule, src-4 fixes the scope to staging and production, and src-5 assigns ownership to Quinton Fairweather. Together they read as the session's conversation-level decision record — the gate, its scope, and its owner.
